subject: Request: Pilot runway support — connectivity lock impacting onboarding (Opsly)
messages:
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@opsly.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@opsly.ai>, procure@opsly.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding blocked — SSO/connectivity lock, request for extension

Hi Tessa —

We're excited to be live with Redwood but hit a hard stop during SSO verification this morning. Our backend team found an intermittent token exchange failure between our IDP and Redwood's onboarding flow; it looks like an edge case in the redirect URI handling.

We ran a quick instrumented test and attached a short snippet of the error and the updated pilot plan for your reference. Our engineering team estimates ~10 business days to fully remediate and validate across environments.

Given the timeline, can Opsly get a 30-day extension on the pilot window and a modest sandbox credit top-up so our devs can continue running end-to-end tests while we fix the issue? The sales/procurement team will want to track any scope changes but this is a blocker for our go/no-go demo next month.

Thanks — really appreciate the help.

Best,
Eleanor Park
Head of Platform | Opsly
eleanor@opsly.ai

Attachments: sso-error-snippet.txt (text), opsly-pilot-plan-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@opsly.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@opsly.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding blocked — SSO/connectivity lock, request for extension

Hi Eleanor —

Thanks for the quick details and the attachments, that helps. Sorry to hear this popped up at the worst time. I've looped in Marissa (CS) and Ben (sales) to evaluate runway and credits.

Short answer: we can provide a temporary pilot-window extension and sandbox credits while your engineers work through the IDP fix. I need to confirm the exact duration and credit amount with the team (and get final approval for the promo bucket), but I'm optimistic we can do 30 days + a small top-up to keep test coverage.

Can you confirm whether the tests require parallel production-like capacity (high token volume) or just steady developer testing? That will help us size the credit top-up. Also, if you can share a couple of steps to reproduce the token-exchange failure we can engage our SREs to triage in parallel.

Appreciate the patience — we'll get back with specifics by EOD tomorrow.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eleanor Park <eleanor@opsly.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@opsly.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding blocked — SSO/connectivity lock, request for extension

Adding color from CS side —

Opsly is mid-pilot, quick adoption and a tight demo date. From our intake call, their traffic profile during tests is modest: repeated auth flows and several long-running embedding jobs, not sustained high throughput. If we give a runway extension + $5,000 sandbox credit it should cover the test churn and keep momentum without needing an engineering commitment from Redwood beyond limited triage.

If Sales approves the $5k credit and Legal/Finance are OK with a one-off promotional top-up, CS will schedule weekly check-ins with Opsly to make sure test coverage completes.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eleanor Park <eleanor@opsly.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@opsly.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding blocked — SSO/connectivity lock, request for extension

Quick note from Sales/RevOps —

Given the deal size and traction (Opsly has committed to a post-pilot POC if onboarding completes), I support a 30-day extension plus a one-time $5,000 sandbox credit. We should tag this as a promotional top-up tied to OPS-1472 and add the extension to the pilot milestone in HubSpot.

Requesting final operational sign-off from Dev/Ops: @Dev — can you confirm we can offer limited triage support (logs review) and that the $5k credit is the appropriate magnitude? If Dev wants a smaller/larger amount, speak up.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eleanor Park <eleanor@opsly.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding blocked — SSO/connectivity lock, request for extension

Ben/Team —

We're good to proceed with limited triage (logs review and a short joint debug session). The engineering team can do a two-hour deep-dive this week and advise on a mitigation path; that won't require a platform change on our side. $5,000 sandbox credit and 30 days extension is acceptable from an operational standpoint.

I'll open the HubSpot activity, note the promo code (PILOT-OPS-5K) and coordinate a DocuSign addendum if legal needs the extension in writing. Marissa — please share the weekly check-in cadence you'd like, and Opsly team, DM me a good time for the debug session.

— Dev Patel
Platform Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@opsly.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@opsly.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding blocked — SSO/connectivity lock, request for extension

Tessa/Team —

Really appreciate the fast coordination and the credit/extension offer. Confirming Opsly accepts the 30-day extension and the $5,000 sandbox credit (PILOT-OPS-5K). We'll schedule the debug session for Wednesday morning PST and share a small reproducer ahead of time.

Thank you all — this keeps our demo timeline alive.

Best,
Eleanor
Head of Platform | Opsly
